title: Determinants of mutation susceptibility along the genome are largely invariant across human tissues.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed both Zenodo records via API. Data record 21805107 (CC-BY-4.0) holds only bigWig tracks of the authors' MODEL-PREDICTED mutation probabilities: 11 exome tracks of ~223 MB each, plus a 22.7 GB whole-genome track, and UCSC hub files. Downloaded the code record 21806414 (399 KB zip, 282 entries): R/shell scripts plus two small predictor-mapping xlsx files; no mutation table, no feature matrix.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 146 features, 25 tissues, use of TCGA Pan-Cancer exome mutations and PCAWG whole-genome mutations (EGA study EGAS00001001692), ENCODE/GTEx/Loyfer methylation inputs, chromosome-22-only genome evaluation. Row counts were not checked; the supplementary tables could not be retrieved (Europe PMC timed out).

a1_downloadable.note: Only model-output bigWigs are deposited. The underlying mutation calls come from TCGA/PCAWG; PCAWG whole-genome calls are partly behind EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive) controlled access, and the features must be rebuilt from ENCODE, GTEx and others. Checked on Zenodo.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No label table exists. Labels (mutated or not, per position or per bin) would have to be constructed by aggregating somatic mutation files across thousands of tumours and matching them to genome positions. Confirmed: the Zenodo code archive holds no data table.

a3_inputs_present.note: The 146 predictors are not deposited; they would have to be recomputed from dozens of ENCODE, Hi-C, replication-timing and expression sources using the authors' R pipeline.

a4_units_stated.note: The bigWigs are probabilities per base; ReadMe present. Not relevant given the other failures.

a5_enough_rows.note: Genome-scale positions would be plentiful once built; no count verified.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: 22.7 GB genome bigWig; rebuilding features needs multi-GB ENCODE downloads
a6_fits_laptop.note: The authors used a high-performance cluster and restricted the genome evaluation to chromosome 22 for computational reasons (paper text).

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not checkable: no row-level table is deposited.

a8_label_provenance.note: The only deposited per-position values are the authors' own random-forest predictions; training on them would distil their model. Real labels need the raw mutation calls.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: no deposited label/feature table to model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use local DNA sequence and chromatin features to predict how likely each genome position is to acquire a somatic mutation in each tissue.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-position genomic features (sequence context, chromatin, replication timing, expression) at positions from tumour exomes and genomes; number of examples unknown, because no table is deposited.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a position carries a somatic point mutation, using mutation calls from TCGA and PCAWG tumour sequencing. These must be rebuilt by hand; the paper deposits only its predictions.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Background mutation-rate maps help cancer driver detection and studies of mutations in healthy tissue, but this paper already provides such maps, and rebuilding them is a cluster-scale job.

ml_idea: Rebuild per-position mutation labels from TCGA/PCAWG calls and predict them from genomic features or DNA language-model embeddings. Rejected because neither the labels nor the features are deposited.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; the 22.7 GB file size is from the Zenodo API. The authors needed a high-performance cluster.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: List the Zenodo records: done. They hold only prediction tracks and code, with no label table.

verdict_reason: Zenodo holds only the authors' predicted mutation-probability tracks and code. The labels (somatic mutations) and the 146 features would have to be rebuilt from TCGA, PCAWG (partly EGA-controlled) and ENCODE on cluster-scale data, so A2, A3, A6 and A8 fail.
